summary: Lesson 13: Advanced Analytics gets BP and HR graphs, reusing the existing chart engine instead of building a new one. Range control unified to 7/30/90/custom (was 7/14/30) across the Trend card and both graphs. LTTB decimation added so 90-day windows stay readable. Retired the old standalone 'View BP Trends'/'View HR Trends' buttons now that Advanced Analytics covers that.
